sql.ahj.permit.detail: SELECT p.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 1 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS submissionContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 6 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS followUpContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 7 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS printLocations, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(notes))) FROM ( SELECT n.id, n.note, n.date_created, n.date_modified, n.created_by_id AS "createdById", created_by.first_name || ' ' || created_by.last_name AS "createdBy", n.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", modified_by.first_name || ' ' || modified_by.last_name AS "modifiedBy" FROM brs.ahj_note n INNER JOIN flow."user" created_by ON n.created_by_id = created_by.id INNER JOIN flow."user" modified_by ON n.modified_by_id = modified_by.id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_note apn ON n.id = apn.ahj_note_id WHERE apn.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND n.archived IS FALSE AND n.note_type_id = 1 ) AS notes), '[]' ) AS notes, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 1 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS submissionChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 2 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS revisionChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 3 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS asBuiltChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 4 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS submissionLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 5 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS followUpLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) FROM ( SELECT upv.user_id AS "id", upv.first_name AS "firstName", upv.last_name AS "lastName", upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name AS "fullName", (select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) from (select o.id AS "orgId", upv.org_level_id AS "orgLevelId", o.org_name AS "orgName", upv.position_level AS "positionLevel" from flow.org o where o.id = upv.org_id) fots ) AS "hierarchy" FROM flow.user_positions_vw upv INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = upv.org_id LEFT JOIN brs.org_metro_area oma ON oma.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN brs.ahj ON ahj.metro_area_id = oma.metro_area_id WHERE upv.end_date IS NULL AND upv.user_archived IS FALSE AND upv.primary_flag IS TRUE AND o.org_type_id = 8 AND ahj.id = p.ahj_id) fots ), '[]' ) AS servicingFots FROM brs.ahj_permit p WHERE p.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.permit.createBlank: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit (ahj_id, deposit_amount, average_permit_fee, engineering_letter_required, print_location, stamped_plan, archived, date_created, created_by_id, business_license_expiration_date, contractor_license_expiration_date, business_license, contractor_license) VALUES (:ahjId, null, null, null, null, null, false, now(), :currentUser, null, null, null, null) RETURNING id
sql.ahj.permit.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit (ahj_id, deposit_amount, average_permit_fee, engineering_letter_required, print_location, stamped_plan, date_created, created_by_id, business_license, contractor_license, business_license_expiration_date, contractor_license_expiration_date) VALUES (:ahjId, :depositAmount, :averagePermitFee, :engineeringLetterRequired, :printLocation, :stampedPlan, now(), :currentUser, :businessLicense, :contractorLicense, :businessLicenseExpirationDate, :contractorLicenseExpirationDate)
sql.ahj.permit.update:
UPDATE brs.ahj_permit SET ahj_id = :ahjId, deposit_amount = :depositAmount, average_permit_fee = :averagePermitFee, engineering_letter_required = :engineeringLetterRequired, print_location = :printLocation, stamped_plan = :stampedPlan, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser, business_license = :businessLicense, contractor_license = :contractorLicense, business_license_expiration_date = :businessLicenseExpirationDate, contractor_license_expiration_date = :contractorLicenseExpirationDate, other_license = :otherLicense, other_license_expiration_date = :otherLicenseExpirationDate, revision_fee_amount = :revisionFeeAmount, as_built_fee_amount = :asBuiltFeeAmount, follow_up_fee_amount = :followUpFeeAmount, delivery_fee_amount = :deliveryFeeAmount, approval_timeline = :approvalTimeline, documents_available = :documentsAvailable,
submission_note = :submissionNote, revision_note = :revisionNote, as_built_note = :asBuiltNote, delivery_note = :deliveryNote WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.link.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit_link (ahj_permit_id, name, link, username, password, notes, date_created, created_by_id, link_type_id) VALUES (:ahjPermitId, :name, :link, :username, :password, :notes, now(), :currentUser, :linkTypeId)
sql.ahj.permit.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET ahj_permit_id = :ahjPermitId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.cycle-time.permits: -- returns data as a JSON array of objects with keys -- dealId, customerName, permitIssuer, submitted, approved, cycleTime select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(permits))) from ( select *, (case when approved is not null then (approved - submitted) else ((now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - submitted) end) as "cycleTime", (case when approved is null then 'pending' else 'approved' end) as status from ( select p.id as "dealId", c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as "customerName", a.name as "permitIssuer", coalesce(permit_revision_c_submittal_date, permit_revision_b_submittal_date, permit_pack_revision_submittal_date, permit_packet_submitted_date) as submitted, (case when permit_revision_c_submittal_date is not null then permit_revision_c_approved_date when permit_revision_b_submittal_date is not null then permit_revision_b_approved_date when permit_pack_revision_submittal_date is not null then permit_pack_revision_approved_date when permit_packet_submitted_date is not null then permit_approved_date end) as approved from flow.project p inner join flow.customer c on c.id = p.customer_id inner join brs.ahj_permit ap on ap.ahj_id = d.ahj_id inner join brs.ahj a on a.id = ap.ahj_id where d.ahj_id = :ahjId order by submitted asc ) s where submitted between :startDate and :endDate ) permits where permits.status = :status
sql.ahj.permit.cycle-time.as-builts: -- returns data as a JSON array of objects with keys -- dealId, customerName, permitIssuer, submitted, approved, cycleTime select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(as_builts))) from ( select p.id as "dealId", c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as "customerName", a.name as "permitIssuer", asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date as submitted, asbuilt_permit_approved_date as approved, (case when asbuilt_permit_approved_date is not null then (asbuilt_permit_approved_date::date - asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date::date) else (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date::date end) as "cycleTime", (case when asbuilt_permit_approved_date is null then 'pending' else 'approved' end) as status from flow.project p inner join flow.customer c on c.id = p.customer_id inner join brs.ahj_permit ap on ap.ahj_id = d.ahj_id inner join brs.ahj a on a.id = ap.ahj_id where asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date between :startDate and :endDate and d.ahj_id = :ahjId order by submitted asc ) as_builts where status = :status
sql.ahj.permit.cycle-time.summary-stats:
select 'permits' as type, status as status, round(avg(t.cycle_time), 2) as avg, cast(median(t.cycle_time) as int) as median, max(t.cycle_time) as max, count(t.cycle_time) as count from ( select (case when s.latest_permit_approval_date is not null then 'approved' else 'pending' end) as status, (case when s.latest_permit_approval_date is not null then (s.latest_permit_approval_date - s.latest_permit_submit_date) else ((now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - s.latest_permit_submit_date) end) as cycle_time from ( select coalesce(permit_revision_c_submittal_date, permit_revision_b_submittal_date, permit_pack_revision_submittal_date, permit_packet_submitted_date) as latest_permit_submit_date, (case when permit_revision_c_submittal_date is not null then permit_revision_c_approved_date when permit_revision_b_submittal_date is not null then permit_revision_b_approved_date when permit_pack_revision_submittal_date is not null then permit_pack_revision_approved_date when permit_packet_submitted_date is not null then permit_approved_date end) as latest_permit_approval_date from blueraven.deal where ahj_id = :ahjId ) s where latest_permit_submit_date between :startDate and :endDate ) t group by t.status
union
select 'as-builts' as type, t.status as status, round(avg(t.cycle_time), 2) as avg, cast(median(t.cycle_time) as int) as median, max(t.cycle_time) as max, count(t.cycle_time) as count from ( select case when asbuilt_permit_approved_date is not null then 'approved' else 'pending' end as status, case when asbuilt_permit_approved_date is not null then (asbuilt_permit_approved_date::date - asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date::date) else (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date::date end as cycle_time from blueraven.deal where ahj_id = :ahjId and asbuilt_permit_pack_submittal_date between :startDate and :endDate ) t group by t.status
